verdict.rationale: Jira's own marketing describes connecting initiatives across teams, prioritizing work, keeping status current, and customizable fields. However, the evidence is high-level feature copy: it never documents an initiative issue type with explicit status, priority, and owning-team fields. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an initiative-level work item, a documented priority field on initiatives, a team-ownership field or attribute, and independent or hands-on corroboration of initiative tracking.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track initiatives with status, priority, and an owning team

citations.quote: Connect engineering, product, and marketing initiatives to coordinate big launches across every team.
